notes: Tap to start sometimes dropped a short first word, such as "Tea" in "Tea, please". The voice detector now starts on a brief moment of speech instead of waiting for a long unbroken stretch of it, and it keeps a little more audio around each thing you say. The same change applies when you resume speaking after a pause, and it lets a short word like "Tea" said on its own come through instead of being ignored. Shorter speech may still be dropped. Push to talk works as before.
